definitions.explanation: The outer covering of the human body.

examples.english: It suits one's skin; it suits one's nature.

examples.japanese: {乾燥|かんそう}で{肌|はだ}がかゆい。
examples.english: My skin is itchy from dryness.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんの{肌|はだ}は{柔|やわ}らかい。
{肌|はだ}を{守|まも}るために{日焼|ひや}け{止|ど}めを{塗|ぬ}った。
examples.english: I put on sunscreen to protect my skin.

examples.japanese: このタオルは{肌触|はだざわ}りがいい。
examples.english: This towel has a nice texture.

examples.japanese: シルクの{肌触|はだざわ}りが{好|す}きです。
examples.english: I like the feel of silk.

examples.japanese: この{布|ぬの}は{肌触|はだざわ}りが{悪|わる}い。
examples.english: This fabric has a bad texture.

examples.japanese: {木|き}の{肌|はだ}がざらざらしている。
examples.english: The texture of the wood is rough.

notes:
{肌|はだ} refers to human skin, particularly focusing on texture, beauty, and feel.

CONTRAST:
- {肌|はだ}: skin (beauty, texture, feel)
- {皮|かわ}: skin, hide, peel (outer layer)
- {皮膚|ひふ}: skin (medical/scientific term)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {肌色|はだいろ}: skin color, flesh tone
- {素肌|すはだ}: bare skin
- {敏感肌|びんかんはだ}: sensitive skin
- {乾燥肌|かんそうはだ}: dry skin
- {脂性肌|しせいはだ}: oily skin
- {肌触|はだざわ}り: texture, feel (of fabric)

EXPRESSIONS:
- {肌|はだ}が{合|あ}う: to suit one's nature, to be compatible
- {肌|はだ}で{感|かん}じる: to feel intuitively
- {鳥肌|とりはだ}が{立|た}つ: to get goosebumps

SKINCARE VOCABULARY:
- {肌|はだ}ケア: skincare
- {美肌|びはだ}: beautiful skin
- {肌|はだ}{荒|あ}れ: rough/irritated skin

RELATED:
- {顔|かお}: face
- {体|からだ}: body
